question: Which of the following trophies was renamed the Anderson‑Tendulkar Trophy in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Test series trophy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Anderson-Tendulkar Trophy** was introduced in **June 2025** to honor two of the most iconic figures in cricket history: **James Anderson** of England and **Sachin Tendulkar** of India.
 
• This trophy is associated with the **Test series** played between **India and England**. It symbolizes the cricketing rivalry and respect shared between these two nations in the longest format of the game.
 
• **James Anderson**, a legendary fast bowler, is England's highest wicket-taker in Tests, while **Sachin Tendulkar** is regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• The renaming of the trophy was seen as a tribute to their **outstanding contributions** to the game and their ability to inspire multiple generations of cricket fans worldwide.
